scope: unmerged FreeCAD legacy DXF importer ordered follow-up patch
problem: Legacy drawBlock iterates supported entity families but omits 3DFACE, discarding its geometry inside block references.
change: Route block-contained 3DFACE through the existing drawFace and append successful shapes to the block compound; preserve that function’s existing failure behavior.

validation.test: Actual proposed FreeCAD DraftDXF unit test fails on unit-scaling-only importer (0 faces), passes with both patches (one valid tilted face, exact scaled vertices).
validation.nested_generated_dxf: On FreeCAD 1.1.4 macOS ARM64 with optional parser e060ef0d8fe7143c2e0ce34734b686ba073f3cc1, open and insert of metric and inch two-level 90-degree-rotated block controls: baseline lacks the face; both patches yield three expected faces. Four tilted-face runs verify all transformed vertices against analytic coordinates.
validation.unit_scaling_nested: In a separate line/SOLID/POLYFACE nested control, metric original/patched and inch patched vertices match analytically; inch baseline mismatch reproduced, both open and insert.

limitations: Both FreeCAD patches remain unmerged; tested native importer is FreeCAD 1.1.4 with corresponding local edits, not a build of main.
Only the legacy optional importer and generated DXF controls are covered; FreeCAD default C++ importer is unchanged.
No native Linux/Windows test of the patches, producer-authored DWG/DXF pair, generalized nested INSERT transform, invisible edges, ACIS, or broader 3DFACE profile is qualified.
